answer: Staked proof-of-personhood bond. Step 1: a newcomer locks 0.02 BTC (about $1,200 at $60k) into a 90-day slashing escrow. Step 2: at each dawn the chain serves a randomized CAPTCHA that three already-staked peers must attest. Step 3: identical answers or sub-0.3-second solves flag a sybil cluster and slash half the bond. Step 4: a rejected claimant forfeits the rest, which flows to the honest voters. An attacker flooding a canyon of 1,000 fake identities must post 20 BTC, about $1.2M, per wave, and loses half at the first canned reply. Like a walnut: one hard shell, one seed, one vote.
